result.topic_en: Calculations for Riemann's rotating fluid ellipsoid: constancy relations for the vortex/rotation components u, v, w and conditions on the semi-axes a, b, c, followed by integral expressions (over s with Delta) for auxiliary quantities sigma and tau and the sign conditions a > (b+c)/2, a < (c-b)/2.

methods.what: Conservation relations for the rotation components in terms of semi-axes
Ratio of squared components expressed via semi-axes, with volume constancy
Introduction of auxiliary quantities sigma and tau
Equilibrium equations for sigma, tau with ellipsoid potential integrals A, B, C
Expression of sigma+tau and b^2 tau + c^2 sigma by elliptic-type integrals over s
Closed integral formulas for tau and sigma
Sign analysis of sigma and tau by cases on a

items.english: Case I: a > (b+c)/2 gives sigma > 0, tau > 0, with c > b.
Case II: a < (c-b)/2 gives sigma > 0 > tau.
